All 143 checks pass. Now let's do ASan/UBSan builds and run the test suites (small ones) under sanitizers.

Note: the private evaluator in this local trial doesn't run sanitizers, but the real task says sanitizer runs must be clean. Let's verify.

Build with: g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer.

Then run: build+lookup on the examples and a few random cases. Check for leaks and UB.

arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wall -Wextra /work/submit/planb64.cpp -o /tmp/planb64_san 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "compiled rc=$?"
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=0
export UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1
/tmp/planb64_san build /work/examples/fib.txt /tmp/s.idx && cmp /tmp/s.idx /work/examples/expected.idx && echo SAN_BUILD_OK
/tmp/planb64_san lookup /tmp/s.idx /work/examples/trace.txt scalar | cmp - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo SAN_SCALAR_OK
/tmp/planb64_san lookup /tmp/s.idx /work/examples/trace.txt batch 3 | cmp - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo SAN_BATCH_OK
/tmp/planb64_san build /work/tmp/nope 2>&1 | head -2; echo "rc=$?"
python3 /work/tmp/gen.py 999 2000 3000 /work/tmp/sfib.txt /work/tmp/strace.txt >/dev/null
/tmp/planb64_san build /work/tmp/sfib.txt /tmp/s2.idx && python3 /work/tmp/ref.py build /work/tmp/sfib.txt | cmp - /tmp/s2.idx && echo SAN_BIG_BUILD_OK
/tmp/planb64_san lookup /tmp/s2.idx /work/tmp/strace.txt batch 251 > /tmp/s2.out && python3 /work/tmp/ref.py lookup /tmp/s2.idx /work/tmp/strace.txt | cmp - /tmp/s2.out && echo SAN_BIG_LOOKUP_OK
/tmp/planb64_san build /work/tmp/err/nul.fib /tmp/x.idx; echo "errcase rc=$?"
